summary: Tested YouTube Shorts testimonial handling + admin video upload (iteration 19). All 8 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows pass: admin upload button uploads mp4 to /api/uploads/vid_, Shorts URL renders as proper /embed/ iframe on Home dialog and course detail (course-review-*-iframe), uploaded video renders as <video> tag with controls (home-video-player + course-review-*-video), mobile 390px admin testimonials tab has no horizontal overflow, image upload still works.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.upload_video reads file in 1MB chunks to GridFS -- good; no explicit size limit though. Consider enforcing a max upload size (e.g., 100MB) to prevent abuse.
routes_courses.get_upload uses GridFSBucket per request (new instance each call). Acceptable but could be lifted to module-level for perf.

Range handler: 'bytes=-N' (suffix range) path works but the parsed start may be negative if size<N; min(end, start + 4MB-1) also may be odd for suffix. Current browsers rarely send suffix ranges for <video>, so OK.

Home.jsx line 80 correctly calls toEmbed() when opening dialog; line 363 iframe then uses activeVideo directly — this works because activeVideo is already an embed URL. Confirmed shorts -> https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id>?autoplay=1.
seed_data_creation: Added 1 uploaded test video to GridFS via admin/upload-video (upload id vid_7dd912a3552c approx). Testimonial list was temporarily modified during the test but RESTORED to its original 3-item state at the end via PUT /api/admin/settings/testimonials. Uploaded test video is still in db.uploads + GridFS; main agent can clean via db.uploads.deleteMany({content_type:/^video\//, created_at:{$gte:'2026-01-07'}}) and the corresponding fs.files/fs.chunks entries if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_video_uploads.py reuses /api/admin/settings for snapshot/restore -- safe. ReviewMedia component (used on course-review-* and group-review-*) uses toEmbed() + isDirectVideo() correctly. Home.jsx openVideo() applies toEmbed before setState so Dialog iframe gets a valid embed URL even for raw Shorts links.
rca of the issue: User's original bug 'Shorts link produced broken iframe' is fixed by: (1) toEmbed() in /app/frontend/src/lib/video.js matches /shorts/<id> and returns https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id>; (2) Home.jsx openVideo() applies toEmbed before setting activeVideo; (3) ReviewMedia.jsx applies toEmbed on play. Vertical upload bug resolved by new POST /api/admin/upload-video (admin only, GridFS-backed, Range-supporting GET), ImageUpload kind='video' + testimonials tab wiring (data-testid testimonial-video-upload-<i>).
